messages:
Maria Chen: Quick pre-weekend handoff — I’ll be offline from ~11:30 PT. TL;DR: small uptick in model-serving 429s (mostly short-lived queuing), planned batcher config tweak at 14:00 PT (non-disruptive target), no open incidents. Leaving a few watch items and actionables below.

Maria Chen: What changed:
- Around 09:40 PT we saw a 2.5x increase in 429s for the text-gen endpoint for ~20m. Root cause looks like transient request burst + one batcher worker reporting OOM then restarting. No user impact post-restart.
- Redis evictions bumped briefly; cache hit rate recovered after TTL enforcement.

Watch:
- 14:00 PT scheduled batcher tuning rollout (rollout tag: batcher-tune-2026-03-17). Watch latencies and 429s for 10m after rollout.
- Node gpu-node-17 has higher p95 CPU and a small GPU memory jitter (observed 2 times this week). Avoid routing long-seq jobs to that node if possible.

Action items:
- Alex Park: take primary oncall from 11:30–19:30 PT? please ack.
- Priya Singh: please monitor DPM dashboards (gen-token-429s, batcher-qdepth) and be ready to rollback if p95 latency > 800ms for more than 2m.
- Samir Patel: can you own escalation to infra if gpu-node-17 trends up?

Maria Chen: Runbook snippet for rollback (copy/paste):
```bash
# rollback batcher config
redwoodctl rollout cancel batcher-tune-2026-03-17 --env prod
redwoodctl apply -f /configs/batcher/previous-stable.yaml
```

Alex Park: Acked. I can take 11:30–19:30 PT. Will join the 14:00 watch window and keep an eye on p95.

Alex Park: Quick question — is the planned change increasing max_batch_size or tuning timeouts?

Maria Chen: It increases max_batch_size from 8→12 and lowers inter-batch timeout from 6ms→4ms. Expect slightly higher throughput, watch memory. Full diff: https://git.internal/redwood/configs/commit/ab12cd (link)

Priya Singh: I’ll be on alert for the 14:00 rollout. I have a lightweight script to poll 429 rate and auto-notify channel if spike > 3rps for 3min. Script run command: `./scripts/alert-429-watch.sh --channel eng-oncall`

deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout 'batcher-tune-2026-03-17' for 2026-03-17T21:00:00Z (14:00 PT). Canary batcher instances: 2/10.

Samir Patel: I can take escalation for gpu-node-17. If it crosses 85% GPU mem for >5m I'll disable long-seq routing. Ping me directly @samir.

oncall-bot: Alerting threshold check — gen-token-429s currently at 0.8rps (baseline 0.3rps). No alerting policy triggered.

Alex Park: If we need to rollback, do we prefer cancelling rollout or scaling rollout to 0%? I prefer cancel → apply stable config (faster).

Maria Chen: Agree cancel + apply stable. Also: if cancel fails, fallback is to scale new replica set to 0 and scale stable up.

Priya Singh: I'll keep the 429 watch script running and post updates here during/after rollout.

Samir Patel: Noted on gpu-node-17. Will add a short runbook in the infra ticket if we hit it.

Alex Park: Taking over now. Thanks Maria — enjoy the weekend 🙌

Maria Chen: Thanks team — appreciate the coverage. Leaving small FYI: internal test-runner will run heavy QA at 02:00 PT tomorrow; non-prod only, but heads-up in case any automated jobs spike infra.

Priya Singh: Copy. I’ll mute non-critical noise but keep the main watches.

Samir Patel: Got it.

Alex Park: Oncall sign-off (me): I’ve got it 11:30–19:30 PT. Will post a quick follow-up after the 14:00 watch. :thumbsup:
